title: Measure how often foreground Codex command events omit both item identity and native turn scope
outcome: Quantify the observed frequency and supported producer versions of foreground Codex command events missing both an item id and native event-turn scope, distinguishing raw protocol evidence from transcript-derived estimates, so the coordinator can assess the explicit non-qualifying compatibility disposition.
acceptance: A reproducible read-only census of retained raw provider/session evidence reports the sampled hosts/versions/time interval, denominator, both-missing event count and whether matching real start/end pairs can be established; missing raw evidence is reported as unknown rather than zero.
The report distinguishes ordinary foreground and late/legacy routes and documents known presentation/dedup biases; it changes no product behavior, user/global configuration or live tracing settings.
The measured coverage and remaining uncertainty are recorded for coordinator disposition, with provenance to the invocation-identity design and its explicit both-missing compatibility decision.
